{"status":1,"message":"查询成功","data_list":[],"page_data":{"offset":1,"limit":20,"total":1299,"pages":65,"hasMore":true},"list_sql":"SELECT t.platform_code, t.account_id, ifNull(t.sku, '') AS sku, t.team_id AS team_id, any(t.account_short_name) AS account_short_name, uniqExact(t.order_id) AS refund_quantity, abs(sum(t.refund_amount_rmb)) AS selling_fee_refund_rmb, abs(sum(t.refund_amount_original_currency)) AS selling_fee_refund_original, argMax(t.currency, t.refund_time) AS currency FROM ads_order_sellersku_profit AS t WHERE t.main_body_id = 8 AND t.data_source = 1 AND t.order_mark = 2 AND t.date_day >= '2026-03-01' AND t.date_day <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY t.platform_code, t.account_id, t.sku, t.team_id HAVING refund_quantity > 0 ORDER BY platform_code, account_short_name, team_id, sku LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0"}
